doc: The project's commands: create, build, test, check, describe, package; dependencies, tools and the design's history.

tools.name: omui.doctor
tools.description: Which tools are there and which are missing (mcpp, xlings, tsc, esbuild), and what each is for

tools.name: omui.templates
tools.description: The templates a project is made from, and what each makes

tools.name: omui.new
tools.description: A new project from a template (app-ts by default): a directory of files, written beside the one the server runs in
tools.undo: none: delete the directory it made

template.description: app-ts, app-cpp, component, native or theme

tools.name: omui.build
tools.description: Builds the project (mcpp build): its outputs under target/, nothing else changed
tools.undo: none needed: target/ is the build's own

rest.description: words passed on to mcpp build as they are (after --)

tools.name: omui.test
tools.description: Runs the project's tests (mtest): which passed, which failed and where
tools.undo: none needed: tests change nothing they keep

rest.description: words passed on to mcpp test as they are (after --: which cases)

tools.name: omui.replay
tools.description: Plays a recording (the protocol's `record`, development mode) in a fresh instance, headless, and checks it ends as it did: the semantic tree's hash and the pixels' (W12)
tools.undo: none needed: a replay keeps nothing

file.description: a file or directory path: the recording (JSON)

tools.name: omui.check
tools.description: Type-checks the project's TypeScript against the API it registers (tsc), or view documents: each problem at its line

files.description: *.view.omui.json documents to check instead of the project

portable.description: also what only this implementation offers (D-157)

tools.name: omui.describe
tools.description: What writing for the project takes: every builder, native module, theme token and verb, as JSON

llms.description: a file or directory path: also write it as llms.txt, for a model's context

tools.name: omui.fmt
tools.description: View documents written in the canonical format; with check, only which are not
tools.undo: the files as they were (version control)

check.description: change nothing: each file not in the canonical format said, exit 1

tools.name: omui.schema
tools.description: The JSON Schema of view documents over the official components (written to out when given)

out.description: a file or directory path: write it to this file

tools.name: omui.video.render
tools.description: A video rendered to files on exact frame and sample counts: WebM (VP9 and Opus), Y4M (and a WAV beside it), a PNG sequence, or a WAV

file.description: a file or directory path: a video description (*.video.omui.ts, or its .json) or a view document (*.view.omui.json)

out.description: a file or directory path: x.webm, x.y4m, x.wav, shots/{:05}.png or shots/

format.description: webm, y4m, png or wav (default: from out)

bitrate.description: WebM: a target bit rate (kbps) instead of a quality

threads.description: WebM: encoder threads (1, the default, gives the same bytes everywhere)

tools.name: omui.video.still
tools.description: One frame of a video as a PNG

file.description: a file or directory path: a video description (*.video.omui.ts, or its .json) or a view document (*.view.omui.json)

out.description: a file or directory path: the PNG

at.description: the frame shown at a time, seconds

tools.name: omui.video.check
tools.description: Whether a video description reads: its problems, or its size, rate, frames and samples

file.description: a file or directory path: a video description (*.video.omui.ts, or its .json) or a view document (*.view.omui.json)

tools.name: omui.video.probe
tools.description: What a WebM, Y4M or WAV file holds (a WebM decoded: its frames and samples counted)

file.description: a file or directory path: a .webm, .y4m or .wav file

tools.name: omui.video.timing
tools.description: Each frame's first sample and length, and its start in nanoseconds

tools.name: omui.audio.automation
tools.description: One timeline gain curve auditioned on a 220 Hz reference tone, offline (no window or device): a WAV, a PNG sheet, a WebP and a report

file.description: a file or directory path: a timeline: a .timeline.omui.ts module, or its .timeline.omui.json

out.description: a file or directory path: the outputs' prefix; its parent directory must exist

fps.description: an exact timeline rate, 1 … 120 (60); the sound is the same

tools.name: omui.deps
tools.description: The project's dependencies as its mcpp.toml declares them

tools.name: omui.tools
tools.description: The tools the project names for xlings, and whether each is installed

tools.name: omui.tools.install
tools.description: Installs the tools the project names (xlings install)
tools.undo: none: xlings remove what it installed

tools.name: omui.config
tools.description: The project's omui.config.ts over the defaults: how far agents may go, what the recorder keeps, whether the designer is linked

tools.name: omui.add
tools.description: Adds a dependency to mcpp.toml (mcpp add)

package.description: a package of mcpp-index, as name or name@version

tools.name: omui.remove
tools.description: Removes a dependency from mcpp.toml (mcpp remove)

tools.name: omui.package
tools.description: Packages the application for people to install (mcpp pack): an artifact written to keep and hand out
tools.undo: none: delete the package it wrote

format.description: a format mcpp pack makes (dist-toy: a Bilibili Toy page)

tools.name: omui.design.sync
tools.description: Carries Live Design's history into git: each design commit a commit on design/<branch>, tags as design/<tag> (the work tree untouched)

dir.description: a file or directory path: the application's directory (here when absent)

tools.name: omui.design.film
tools.description: The design's history as a film (WebM): each step as it was presented, captioned

out.description: a file or directory path: the film (design.webm)
